{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Build"
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - "*-jdk11"
      - "*/*-jdk11"
    tags-ignore:
      - "*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: "Cache Maven repository"
        uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
        with:
          path: $HOME/.m2
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
      - name: "JDK set-up"
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '26'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: "Build"
        run: |
          mvn clean install -B -DskipTests -Dorg.slf4j.simpleLogger.log.org.apache.maven.cli.transfer.Slf4jMavenTransferListener=warn -P compatibility-mode
  test-and-quality-check:
    name: "Test and quality check"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: "Cache Maven repository"
        uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
        with:
          path: $HOME/.m2
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
      - name: "Extract build information"
        id: build_info
        run: |
          echo "SOURCE_BRANCH=${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: "JDK set-up"
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '26'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: "Test and Quality check"
        uses: nick-invision/retry@v4
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.build_info.outputs.SOURCE_BRANCH }}
        with:
          max_attempts: 10
          timeout_minutes: 15
          retry_on: error
          command: |
            mvn verify jacoco:report-aggregate -P compatibility-mode
      - name: "Upload coverage baseline"
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: jacoco-coverage-baseline
          path: bull-report/target/site/jacoco-aggregate/jacoco.xml
          retention-days: 90
      - name: "Submit coverage to Coveralls"
        if: ${{ env.COVERALLS_IO_TOKEN != '' }}
        env:
          COVERALLS_IO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COVERALLS_IO_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          mvn coveralls:report -DrepoToken=$COVERALLS_IO_TOKEN
  security-check:
    name: "Security check"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: "Cache Maven repository"
        uses: actions/cache@v6.1.0
        with:
          path: $HOME/.m2
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
      - name: "JDK set-up"
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '26'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: "Checkout repository"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      # Initializes the CodeQL tools for scanning.
      - name: "Initialize CodeQL"
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.39.3
        with:
          languages: 'java'
      - run: |
          mvn clean install -B -DskipTests -P fast
      - name: "Perform Analysis"
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.39.3",
  "rationale": "Dependency caching via actions/cache is already present in all three jobs, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is satisfied. There is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST not applicable), no schedule (schedule-based patterns not applicable), and the build is Maven rather than Bazel. The remaining supported, minimal optimization is to cancel superseded in-progress runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). Adding a top-level concurrency group keyed by workflow and git ref with cancel-in-progress true partitions cancellation by branch or PR, lets the latest revision still run required checks to completion, and adds no new secrets, permissions, network access, or deployment steps.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
